And we'll tell you what matters for investors in Europe, giving you insight before trading begins. On today's show, gold extended losses, after its biggest plunge in more than a decade on Friday, as silver also sank deeper, reversing a record-breaking rally that appeared to have run too far, too fast. Technology stocks fell as concerns over stretched valuations and heavy investment in AI drove MSCI’s Asian tech gauge to its steepest decline since November.
